verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs describe a dedicated, native PostgreSQL database "you connect to directly" with psql, Prisma, or Drizzle, plus pooling, so developers can use standard clients and ORMs. The older community remarks that Appwrite is not built on Postgres predate this offering and do not contradict it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of connection-string format and credentials, clarity on whether direct access covers the default managed/shared database or only the dedicated PostgreSQL tier, independent hands-on corroboration
